creatives.angle: the recording that stops at minute 55
creatives.primary_text: A lecture recorder in development for students. It saves your audio to your phone as you record, so a crash or a phone call does not take the whole lecture. Early access, nothing is charged today.
creatives.headline: Record the whole lecture. Never lose it.

creatives.primary_text: Phone call mid-lecture? Full storage? The concept: your interrupted recording is recovered the next time you open the app. In development. Join the early-access list, nothing is charged today.
creatives.headline: Get the interrupted recording back

creatives.primary_text: See how much of your lecture is saved while you record, and check storage before it starts. A concept in development. Early access, nothing is charged today.
creatives.headline: See your lecture being saved
